scope: native NaN16 angular ring addressing and the next native learning/trigonometry primitives

ring.rule: angular rotation maps only 0..254; position 255 is never returned by the map

kernels.abi: r1=real lane 0..254, r2=signed offset -> r3=mapped lane, r4=255 fixed NANNET0, r5=1
r1=current base, r2=source base, r3=gain in [0,1]
r1=support, r2=oppose -> conflict=min, balance=support-oppose, both preserved

implemented_behaviors: 255-lane angular rotation with NANNET0 fixed at 255
oscillatory per-channel write gates clamped to [0,1]
gated cycle-bank retention/consolidation toward a source bank
contradiction pair preserving support, oppose, conflict, and balance
16-candidate nonnegative attention/value mixing without forced top-1 selection
phase_bind: mth.trig.rotate.f32 is the native phase-bind primitive; bank-level binding is a caller composition of rotate, cycle predict, and cycle write, not a second geometry authority.
non_claims: No rotation of NANNET0; point 0 is not a ring position.
No claim that oscillatory gates improve learning.
No truth collapse in the contradiction primitive; conflict/balance are not probabilities.
No top-1 forcing in the attention mix; weights are caller-supplied and unnormalized.
No full attention, transformer, or fluent LM.
No host trigonometry or host numerical substitution at runtime.
No CI, live deployment, or production claim from local fixtures.
